notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Krav by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Krav ability, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life, and put a +1/+1 counter on Krav.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
